editorial:
Imagine you finally get the perfect guy to propose to you, but then you find out your weird neighbor is standing in the way of your dream home. That is exactly what happens to Claire, a high-powered boss who just wants to turn her place into a fancy duplex. Enter Alain, a quirky designer who lives in the room above her and simply refuses to leave. You will love the spark between these two because they are total opposites. She is all about rules and schedules, while he is just going with the flow. The vibe is light, fluffy, and feels like a warm hug on a rainy afternoon.

The acting is natural and the chemistry between the leads makes the fighting feel like flirting. While the plot is pretty predictable, it never feels boring because the dialogue is snappy and fun. If you are in the mood for something sweet and low-stress, you should definitely check this out. It is the perfect choice for a lazy Sunday night when you just want to smile.
endingExplained: After plenty of arguing and funny mishaps, Claire realizes that her fiancé is actually too boring and controlling for her. She discovers that Alain is the one who truly understands her and makes her happy. In the final scenes, she breaks off her engagement to André. She and Alain decide to stop fighting over the apartment and instead start a romantic relationship, choosing love and spontaneity over a perfect house layout.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves classic rom-coms and enemies-to-lovers stories.
